$comment: Third-party binaries embedded in CloudBox.Server.Setup.exe. CI downloads each from its pinned URL, refuses any SHA-256 mismatch, and embeds it. Binaries are never committed. Update: change url + sha256 together in one reviewed commit.

components.name: rdpWrapper
components.licence: No OSS licence in the upstream repository. Commercial bundling by direct permission of the author (Sergiy Egoshyn); evidence in the private legal records (spec §4.7). Bundled inside it: TermWrap, UmWrap, EndpWrap, RDPWrapOffsetFinder (llccd, MIT); rdpwrap.dll/ini (stascorp, Apache-2.0); Zydis (zyantific, MIT).
